name: CT Initialization via Fan Beam Ray Transform and FBP
definition: Initializes CT reconstruction by computing a reference image via Fan beam ray transform and filtered back projection (FBP), then creates a sparse sinogram by subsampling and resizing.
summary: CT Initialization via Fan Beam Ray Transform and FBP initializes 3D volumes by combining fan beam ray transforms with filtered back projection and multiplicative updates based on voxel visibility.
